name: Regulatory & Agency Alert Monitor

parameters.content:
## Regulatory & Agency Alert Monitor

### How it works

1. The workflow triggers weekly to check configured regulatory RSS feeds for new items.
2. It tags and groups feed items by practice area, drafting a regulatory digest.
3. The digest or a setup notice is logged to Google Sheets and emailed for review.
4. Separately, a weekly trigger checks for stale regulatory drafts pending review.
5. If stale drafts exist, it sends reminder emails; otherwise, it skips notification.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure RSS feed URLs for regulatory agencies in the workflow settings.
- [ ] Set up Google Sheets credentials and provide access to the digest drafts log spreadsheet.
- [ ] Configure email sending credentials and verify SMTP or email service integration.
- [ ] Adjust keywords by practice area in the code nodes as needed for tagging.
- [ ] Configure timing for the two schedule triggers to run weekly as intended.

### Customization

Modify the keyword lists in the tagging code to tailor practice area relevance. Adjust email content and recipients in the emailSend nodes to suit distribution preferences.

## Trigger and feed validation

Starts the workflow on a weekly schedule and checks if feed URLs are configured before proceeding.

## Build and fetch feeds

Transforms configured feed URLs into list items and reads each RSS feed for agency alerts.

## Tag and draft digest

Tags items based on practice area keywords, drafts the regulatory digest, or creates a setup-needed notice if no feeds configured.

## Digest ID and review logging

Assigns a unique digest ID, logs the digest draft to Google Sheets, builds an email for review request, and sends it.

## Stale drafts detection trigger and read

Triggers weekly to read the log of regulatory digest drafts and looks for stale items still pending review.

## Stale drafts reminder email

Builds and sends reminder emails if stale regulatory drafts are detected, or skips if none found.

nodes.name: If Feed URLs Are Configured
nodes.notes: Checked here, while there's still guaranteed exactly one item from the trigger -- an unconfigured AGENCY_BAR_FEED_URLS routes to a setup-needed notice instead of the run silently dying at zero items.

nodes.name: Build List of Feed URLs
nodes.notes: AGENCY_BAR_FEED_URLS is the entire source list — a comma-separated list of RSS feed URLs (state bar publications, agency press releases, regulator feeds).

nodes.name: Build Setup Required Notice
nodes.notes: Fires only when AGENCY_BAR_FEED_URLS is empty — keeps the log and review email showing up on schedule even before feeds are configured.

nodes.name: Fetch Agency Bar RSS Feeds
nodes.notes: Runs once per feed URL from the list above, fetching that feed's current items.

nodes.name: Tag Items by Practice Area
nodes.notes: PRACTICE_AREA_KEYWORDS and DIGEST_LOOKBACK_DAYS control what makes it into the digest and how it's tagged. An item with zero practice-area matches is dropped.

nodes.name: Build Regulatory Digest Content
nodes.notes: Groups the tagged items by practice area — the same item can appear under multiple areas if it matched keywords in more than one.

nodes.name: Assign Unique Digest ID
nodes.notes: This ID ties the sheet row to this run.

const d = $json;
return { json: { ...d, digest_id: 'REGDIGEST-' + Date.now(), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } };

nodes.name: Append Digest Draft to Sheets
nodes.notes: Every weekly run gets a row here, even a 'nothing matched this week' one. Column headers must match exactly.

nodes.name: Build Digest Review Email
nodes.notes: Falls back the recipient to FIRM_FROM_EMAIL if CONTENT_REVIEWER_EMAIL isn't set, so a missing variable can't crash the send.

nodes.name: Send Digest Review Email
nodes.notes: This is an internal Protomated notification, not a client communication — no compliance guardrail wrap needed.

nodes.name: When Weekly at 9am Thursday
nodes.notes: Runs weekly, Thursday 9am by default — a few days after the Monday digest.

nodes.name: Read Digest Drafts Log from Sheets
nodes.notes: Reads the full log — filtered down to stale pending drafts in the next step.

nodes.name: Find Stale Pending Drafts
nodes.notes: STALE_DRAFT_REMINDER_DAYS controls the age threshold — defaults to 5 days.

nodes.name: If Stale Regulatory Drafts Found
nodes.notes: Only sends a reminder when there's actually something stale.

nodes.name: Build Stale Draft Reminder Email
nodes.notes: Runs once for the whole batch of stale drafts, not once per draft.

nodes.name: Send Stale Draft Reminder Email
nodes.notes: This is an internal Protomated notification — no compliance guardrail wrap needed.

nodes.name: Skip When No Stale Drafts Found
nodes.notes: Nothing to nudge about this run — every draft has either been reviewed or is still fresh.

description: Internal Protomated tool, Authority pillar, not deployed to clients. Runs weekly: pulls a configurable list of public agency/bar RSS feeds, tags each recent item against a configurable practice-area keyword map (an item can affect more than one area, or none), drafts a plain-English digest grouped by affected practice area, logs the draft, and emails it to a content reviewer. Separately, a stale-draft reminder nudges the reviewer if a draft sits unreviewed too long. Nothing publishes without a human review pass. Feeds Protomated's own newsletter/Field Notes content pipeline and BD conversations.
